text:
Anika (CS): Heads up — Pinebrook Health wants to onboard a private model for patient-note summarization (PHI). They need: US-only data residency, HSM/KMS for keys, model artifact upload to their S3, and a safety eval before go-live. Contract renewal in 6 weeks, they may push for a fast timeline. Can we scope owners and estimate ETA?
Emily (Solutions): Thanks Anika. Do we know target QPS and avg tokens? That affects Dedicated vs Private sizing.
Anika (CS): Customer says ~20 reqs/min, avg 200 tokens in, 300 out. Mostly during business hours. They prefer 13B quantized to 8-bit.
Li (Infra): For Private with HSM we'll need VPC peering + HSM certificate exchange. Rough infra lead time 2-3 weeks once customer signs off on KMS handshake.
Jordan (ML Eng): For safety/evals: we'll need ~200 labeled notes for PHI recall/precision and hallucination checks. Do they have a holdout set or should we generate synthetic?
Anika (CS): They can provide 150 real de-identified notes + want us to run synthetic edgecases. Upload link: https://redwood.internal/s3/pinebrook/onboard-samples (internal)
Security-bot: Checklist: https://redwood.internal/ops/hsm-onboard-checklist. Make sure policy `kms:Encrypt` and `kms:DescribeKey` are allowed by customer KMS role.
Emily (Solutions): I'll own solutioning and customer enablement. @Li can you confirm network checklist by EOD Friday?
Li (Infra): Yep, will validate VPC, subnets, and HSM certs. Blocking items: customer security approvals and KMS rotation policy.
Jordan (ML Eng): I'll draft eval plan: PHI recall, hallucination rate, token latency P95. Need a contact to share eval labels. @Anika who at Pinebrook to coordinate?
Anika (CS): Point of contact is Maia Chen (maia.chen@pinebrookhealth.com). I'll intro and send calendar for kickoff tomorrow 10am PT.
Emily (Solutions): Great. Tentative timeline: infra ready 2-3w, model validation 1w, canary deploy 2 days. Calls out renewal risk — we'll flag to AM.
Anika (CS): Adding to renewal tracker and looping AM. Thanks all :tada:
